es.title: Optimizar costos operativos
es.outcome: Diagnóstico de gastos con recomendaciones para reducir sin afectar calidad.
es.prompt:
Quiero reducir costos operativos sin afectar la calidad del servicio.

Mi negocio: [describir].
Gastos mensuales principales: [listar con monto aproximado].
Ingresos mensuales aproximados: [monto].

Dame: análisis de qué gastos son críticos vs opcionales, 5 oportunidades concretas de ahorro priorizadas por impacto, riesgos de cada recorte y plan de implementación.

en.title: Optimize operating costs
en.outcome: Expense diagnosis with recommendations to reduce costs without affecting quality.
en.prompt:
I want to reduce operating costs without affecting service quality.

My business: [describe].
Main monthly expenses: [list with approximate amount].
Approximate monthly revenue: [amount].

Give me: analysis of which expenses are critical vs optional, 5 concrete cost-saving opportunities prioritized by impact, risks of each cut and an implementation plan.
